<mxfile host="Portitor" type="device"><diagram id="c4" name="C1 System context: Portitor"><mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" page="0" background="#FFFFFF"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/><mxCell id="operator" value='<b>Participant&#x27;s operator</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[Person]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Runs Portitor for vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="60" y="90" width="250" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="issuer" value='<b>Portitor issuer</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[Software system]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">portitor-issuer, run by the dataspace authority, one per dataspace: issues and revokes credentials</font>' style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1168BD;strokeColor=#0B4884;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=system;c4Name=Portitor issuer;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="560" y="80" width="300" height="150" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="authority" value='<b>Dataspace authority&#x27;s operator</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[Person]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Decides who joins the dataspace</font>' style="rounded=1;arcSize=30;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#08427B;strokeColor=#073B6F;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=person;c4Name=Dataspace authority's operator;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1040" y="60" width="250" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="portitor" value='<b>Portitor</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[Software system]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">One participant&#x27;s connector and identity in a dataspace</font>' style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1168BD;strokeColor=#0B4884;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=system;c4Name=Portitor;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="480" y="400" width="300" height="140" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="partner" value='<b>Other participant</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[Software system]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">Another organisation&#x27;s connector and identity: Portitor, EDC or any DSP + DCP implementation</font>' style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#8C8496;strokeColor=#736782;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=external;c4Name=Other participant;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1000" y="400" width="280" height="140" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="source" value='<b>Data source</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">[Software system]</font><br><br><font style="font-size:11px">The participant&#x27;s own HTTP service behind each dataset</font>' style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#8C8496;strokeColor=#736782;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;c4Kind=external;c4Name=Data source;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="60" y="620" width="250" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="e0" value="Publishes datasets, starts negotiations and transfers, requests credentials
[management APIs, HTTPS, API key]" style="endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#707070;fontSize=11;fontColor=#404040;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=1.000;exitY=0.500;exitPerimeter=0;entryX=0.100;entryY=0.000;entryPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="operator" target="portitor"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><Array as="points"><mxPoint x="510" y="150"/></Array></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="e1" value="Requests credentials, reads the DID document and status lists
[DCP issuance API, HTTPS]" style="endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#707070;fontSize=11;fontColor=#404040;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.400;exitY=0.000;exitPerimeter=0;entryX=0.133;entryY=1.000;entryPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="portitor" target="issuer"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="e2" value="Delivers credentials
[DCP storage API]" style="endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#707070;fontSize=11;fontColor=#404040;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.667;exitY=1.000;exitPerimeter=0;entryX=0.933;entryY=0.000;entryPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="issuer" target="portitor"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="e3" value="Registers participants, offers and revokes credentials
[management API, API key]" style="endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#707070;fontSize=11;fontColor=#404040;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.000;exitY=0.500;exitPerimeter=0;entryX=1.000;entryY=0.233;entryPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="authority" target="issuer"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="e4" value="Reads catalogs, negotiates contracts, pulls data, proving who it is
[DSP 2025-1, DCP 1.0.1]" style="endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#707070;fontSize=11;fontColor=#404040;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=1.000;exitY=0.286;exitPerimeter=0;entryX=0.000;entryY=0.286;entryPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="portitor" target="partner"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="e5" value="The same, the other way round" style="endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#707070;fontSize=11;fontColor=#404040;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.000;exitY=0.786;exitPerimeter=0;entryX=1.000;entryY=0.786;entryPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="partner" target="portitor"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="e6" value="Gets and checks credentials the same way" style="endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#707070;fontSize=11;fontColor=#404040;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;dashed=1;exitX=0.500;exitY=0.000;exitPerimeter=0;entryX=1.000;entryY=0.800;entryPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="partner" target="issuer"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><Array as="points"><mxPoint x="1140" y="200"/></Array></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="e7" value="Fetches the data it serves
[HTTP]" style="endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#707070;fontSize=11;fontColor=#404040;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.267;exitY=1.000;exitPerimeter=0;entryX=1.000;entryY=0.500;entryPerimeter=0;" edge="1" parent="1" source="portitor" target="source"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><Array as="points"><mxPoint x="560" y="680"/></Array></mxGeometry></mxCell><mxCell id="legend" value="C4 model, level 1. Blue: Portitor; each participant runs its own, and the dataspace authority runs one issuer. Grey: outside Portitor. Arrows point from the caller to the one called." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;fontColor=#555555;whiteSpace=wrap;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="760" width="1300" height="40" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
